notes: Target-machine parameters layered on the frozen reconstructed source model.
Archive files under sample_weight_file/ are never modified; frozen hashes stay valid.
source wheel radius is read back from the generated MJCF and must match 0.055 m before patching.
Nothing here accepts the target robot; V5 regression and target training remain pending.

wheel.note: progress.md §2.5: M3508 built-in reducer drives a 16T->19T chain; Mk4 planetary is not in the power path.

leg_motor.profile: archived output-shaft ratings retained: 20 Nm rated / 40 Nm peak / 100 rpm rated / 160 rpm no-load at 24 V, integrated 9:1

spring.anchors: archived resolved anchors in URDF link frames retained; local CAD assembly/nominal pin distances differ by <=0.25 mm
spring.evidence: progress.md §2.4 measured/user: 450 N nominal, free length ~250 mm, stroke 75 mm

environment.note: Wheel radius +5 mm; raise spawn z by 5 mm so wheels stay on the ground. Command clearance remains 0.10 m.

knee_stop_note: 75 mm stroke bottoms out at 175 mm pin distance; the compression side is enforced as a knee joint stop. The extension end (250 mm) is unreachable at full extension (about 249.3 mm).
unchanged_from_source: mass/inertia from the archived URDF (user convention)
low reset pose and joint conventions
frame timing: 5 ms external PD, 2.5 ms physics substep, 10 ms policy step
limitations: Wheel inertia is not re-derived for the 0.055->0.060 m radius change.
M3508 torque-speed envelope is the P19 proxy scaled by the 19/16 chain ratio.
Spring force is a constant 450 N nominal model without progression.
Archived URDF effort/velocity limits remain source values; validate_hardware_asset is not run for this profile.
No domain randomization is enabled by this profile.
